title: THE KEEL · ROTATION LAPS
why: Monday loaded squats, cleans and jerks, so today pulls and twists: six stations of rowing and anti-rotation work, each lap exiting on a steady fifth of a mile. Laps in 24 minutes, lungs at a steady burn instead of a sprint.

blocks.title: WARM-UP · 6 MIN · ONE PASS
blocks.meta: Moves Method Day A · shoulders / spine / wrists + row groove

items.name: Squat overhead reach-out ×8
items.detail: sit in the squat, reach both arms overhead and hold 2 counts

items.name: Jefferson curl ×6
items.detail: bodyweight, roll down one vertebra at a time

items.name: Thoracic rotations ×8/side
items.detail: on all fours, hand behind head

blocks.title: THE KEEL · LAPS IN 24:00
blocks.meta: AMRAP LAPS · 24:00 · 6 stations + 1 steady leg per lap · 35 / 45 / 60 lb
blocks.format: One clock, 24:00. A lap is the six stations in order, then the belt. Move straight through; the only rest is the walk to the treadmill. Score = laps finished. Log laps, the slowest station, and RPE.
blocks.workRest: LEG every lap: 0.20 mi at 7.4 mph console flat (about 1:37), cadence quick and short, ~168 steps a minute. This is a steady leg, not a sprint: same speed every lap.

items.name: S1 · Dead-start rotational clean 45 lb ×5/side
items.detail: bell starts on the floor outside the opposite foot, rotate and clean to the rack, set it down dead each rep

items.name: S2 · Plank single-arm row 45 lb ×8/side
items.detail: feet wide, hips square to the floor, elbow to the ribs

items.name: S3 · Kneeling single-arm upright row 35 lb ×10/side
items.detail: tall-kneeling, elbow leads, bell to the sternum

items.name: S4 · One-hand lateral carry walk 60 lb ×10 steps each way
items.detail: bell in one hand, step sideways, stay dead level, switch hands on the way back

items.name: S5 · Half-kneeling Pallof hold-out 35 lb ×8/side
items.detail: bell held at the chest, push it straight out and back, do not let it pull you around

items.name: S6 · Pilates saw ×6/side
items.detail: seated, legs wide, reach the opposite hand past the little toe, exhale as you reach

blocks.noteGreen: Green (today): 5 laps in 24:00. Stretch: a 6th lap started before 21:00 and finished before the clock.
blocks.noteYellow: Yellow: 4 laps, S1 and S2 on the 35 lb bell, leg at 7.0.
blocks.text: The Pilates saw is new: sit tall, legs wide, arms out to the sides, twist and reach the right hand toward the left foot like a saw past the toe, come back tall, switch. Dead-start clean: the bell comes to a complete stop on the floor between reps.

blocks.title: MIDLINE CLOSE · 3 ROUNDS
blocks.meta: 3 ROUNDS · dead bug + lateral plank lift + roll-up · straight through

items.name: Dead bug, 35 lb held above the chest ×8/side
items.detail: bell locked out above the chest, opposite arm and leg lower slowly

items.name: Lateral plank hip lifts ×10/side
items.detail: on the forearm, hips drop and lift

items.name: Pilates roll-up ×8
items.detail: arms overhead, peel off the floor one vertebra at a time, fold over the legs
